pages.title: Jantz Wealth Advisors | Retirement Planning and Investment Management
pages.description: Jantz Wealth Advisors is a retirement planning and investment management firm. We are hybrid advisors who turn your savings into a steady retirement paycheck, invest the rest with discipline, and keep the whole plan current.

pages.title: The Design Profile | Jantz Wealth Advisors
pages.description: An 18-question assessment that reveals how you want your retirement designed, then builds your personalized Retirement Stack.

pages.title: The Global Core Portfolios | Jantz Wealth Advisors
pages.description: The four Global Core portfolios used by Jantz Wealth Advisors: Conservative, Moderate, Balanced, and Growth. See what each one holds and how each is built.

pages.title: Investment Strategy Assessment (ISA) | Jantz Wealth Advisors
pages.description: A 12-question assessment that matches you to one of the four Global Core portfolios based on your time horizon, capacity for risk, and comfort with risk.

pages.title: Fees | Jantz Wealth Advisors
pages.description: How Jantz Wealth Advisors is compensated. One clear advisory fee with a cap built in, plus a plain explanation of the hybrid approach and why it can lower the advisory fee on your whole retirement portfolio.

pages.title: Schedule a Conversation | Jantz Wealth Advisors
pages.description: Request a conversation with Jantz Wealth Advisors. Tell us a little about where you are and we will call you within 12 to 24 hours. No cost, no obligation, and no account minimum.
